messages:
priya: Quick question — console preflight flagged a 'header-override-priority' lint error for this route but the YAML looks fine to me.

priya: Here's the minimal route:
```
route:
  match:
    path_prefix: /api/v1
  headers:
    - name: x-tenant
      value: "tenant-foo"
  overrides:
    upstream_headers:
      x-tenant: request.header.x-tenant
```

nick: Hmm, the lint rule complains when a header exists both in 'headers' and 'overrides' — it's trying to prevent accidental shadowing.

alina: I remember we made that lint to avoid silent precedence flips between anchored-match headers vs explicit override mapping.

priya: But in this case 'headers' is matching on incoming header and 'overrides.upstream_headers' is mapping it to upstream header with same key — it's intentional. The rule seems too strict.

lint-bot: ERROR route.yaml: line 6: header-override-priority: 'headers' and 'overrides.upstream_headers' both reference "x-tenant" — potential ambiguity.

kai: Can you paste the full config? Sometimes console preflight normalizes casing and it triggers the rule.

priya: Full slice:
```
route:
  id: tenant-route
  match:
    method: ANY
    path_prefix: /api/v1
    headers:
      - name: x-tenant
        value: "tenant-foo"
  priority: 10
  destination: tenant-service
  overrides:
    upstream_headers:
      x-tenant: request.header.x-tenant
```

nick: I think lint-bot flags because rule treats 'headers' as incoming match constraints and warns when same key is proxied upstream — earlier bug where match header was dropped by proxy.

alina: Proposal: change lint to 'warning' and add actionable hint to console: "If you intend to proxy the same header, mark intent with 'preserve_header: true' on the match entry". Add automatic fix suggestion.

priya: I like the 'preserve_header' knob. Minimal UX change and makes intent explicit.

kai: Implementation notes: schema change + default false. Linter should accept when preserve_header: true OR when overrides.upstream_headers maps from request.header.<name> explicitly. Also add unit tests covering case-insensitive header names.

nick: I'll open a PR to schema + linter. Test cases I want:
- match header only -> no warning
- match header + override mapping to literal -> warn
- match header + override mapping to request.header.<same> -> allow only if preserve_header:true or explicit mapping

priya: Also add console hint link to design doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/routing/header-preserve

lint-bot: NOTE: Suggested autofix available: add `preserve_header: true` to the header match. Run `/lint apply-fix 2162501234` to auto-apply in console dry-run.

alina: We should be careful with rolling this out. Start with non-blocking warning in hosted, block in Dedicated until fix is validated.

kai: Sounds good. Nick — assign me as reviewer on the PR and I'll add SRE tests for header propagation across edge LB.

nick: Will do. I'll also add an e2e harness to exercise the console preflight flow so we catch parsing/casing differences.

priya: Thanks everyone. Filing follow-ups: PR when ready, and a short note in release notes about the new 'preserve_header' field. :thumbsup:
